messages:
maria: quick design review - i added a compact inline diff for tool outputs in the playground run history. screenshot/PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/ux/merge/1234
kevin: nice. love the space savings. does the diff hide the original output by default? might be confusing when debugging.
maria: default shows a one-line summary + +/- badge. expand to full diff with a chevron. goal is to surface regressions without noise.
sam: +1 for summary. can we also show run-level metadata (tokens, model id) collapsed under a small chevron? helpful to know what caused the change.
jess: a11y nits: the chevron needs an aria-label and keyboard target. current prototype only responds to clicks.
maria: agreed. will add tabindex and aria-expanded. proposal: aria-label="Toggle tool output diff" and roving focus support.
kevin: ux question: when multiple tool calls happen in one invocation, do we stack diffs inline or collapse to a single combined diff? stacking could get long.
alex: prefer per-tool diffs but collapse repeated identical outputs into a compact row ("x3 identical").
sam: perf note: rendering full diffs for large outputs kills initial paint. we should virtualize and only render expanded diffs.
jess: copy tweak: summary currently says "Tool output changed" 14 can we use something shorter and clearer like "Output delta 14 expand" for narrow widths?
maria: updated copy in the PR to "Output delta 14 expand" and added a tooltip on hover: "Click to open full diff".
kevin: also thinking about function-def schema editor interaction: if a function's return schema changes across runs we should surface a structured schema diff, not just text.
alex: yes 14 show a tiny schema badge "sig diff" that expands a field-by-field comparer. reuse json-diff view.
sam: implementation detail: compute schema diffs server-side during run evals and attach a diff payload to run metadata so the client doesn't compute heavy diffs.
jess: a11y: schema diff needs good color contrast and non-color indicators for adds/removals (icons + text). also provide screenreader summary like "3 fields added, 1 removed".
maria: action items: 1) add aria attributes + keyboard behavior, 2) virtualize expanded diffs, 3) attach server-side schema-diff payloads, 4) shorten copy. i'll push follow-up commits tonight.
kevin: mock request: include an example where a tool returned a chart (svg) and a text change - how to surface non-text diffs? maybe show "binary changed" placeholder with "Preview" button.
maria: good call. i'll add "Preview" and "Download output" actions for binary/blobs.
dev-bot: PR 1234: updated 14 4 new commits pushed by maria. CI: unit tests passed, a11y checks flagged 2 missing labels.
jess: i'll pick up the two a11y label failures tomorrow and add tests.
alex: one more thought 14 in run history list view maybe show a tiny pill "tool-delta" so folks can quickly scan runs with regressions.
sam: i like that. badge could be green/yellow/red based on semantic diff severity.
maria: thanks all 14 will iterate and post a new screenshot in this thread when done :thumbsup:
kevin: thanks! :rocket:
